mapper.select: SELECT a.username,a.display_name,t.name AS tenant_name,COALESCE(d.name,'') AS department_name,a.profile_revision AS revision FROM c2k_account a JOIN c2k_tenant t ON t.id=a.tenant_id LEFT JOIN c2k_member_department m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.member_id=a.id LEFT JOIN c2k_department d ON d.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND d.id=m.department_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.id=#{member}

SELECT r.name FROM c2k_role r JOIN c2k_account a ON a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.id=#{member} WHERE r.id=a.role OR (r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM c2k_member_role m WHERE m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.member_id=a.id AND m.role_id=r.id )) ORDER BY r.name,r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE c2k_account SET display_name=#{name},profile_revision=profile_revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{member} AND profile_revision=#{revision} AND enabled
UPDATE c2k_account SET password_hash=#{hash},auth_version=auth_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{member} AND auth_version=#{authVersion} AND enabled
